The §6Network Tool§f is AE2's diagnostic handheld. Right-click any AE2 block to inspect its settings in a GUI. Sneak-right-click to get a full network breakdown showing power draw, channel usage, and cable density.

Shapeless recipe: §6Illuminated Panel§f + §6Wooden Chest§f + §6Quartz Wrench§f + §6Calculation Processor§f.

The network breakdown view shows which blocks consume the most power, helping you identify bottlenecks. It also displays the channel topology of your cable network.

§ePS:§f Keep one in your hotbar for quick diagnostics. A §6Security Terminal§f can restrict who uses the Network Tool on your network.
